imagePolicies.legacyScheduleFields: autoUpdateInterval and pollingInterval omitted from reads/schema; any write including null or mixed fields refuses before forwarding
imagePolicies.notificationCommit: candidate dedup row and linked durable notification entry in one hub transaction
imagePolicies.notificationRecovery: reuse entry across checks, restart and policy toggles; failed/unknown delivery never creates another entry

vulnerability.baseline: last completed image findings survive failed attempts
